components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Scarce Harbor Steel action: Generate, Anonymize, Validate.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M13 2L3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z"/></svg>Generate</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 500 13px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 500 13px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Rail footer and icon-only theme toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 500 11px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Card
components.description: Input or result pane. Flat, hairline, 12px corners.
components.html:
JSON Skeleton

Paste a skeleton, then generate.

Editor
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground)); } .ds-card-h { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-t { font: 500 15px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-d { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-card-b { padding: 0 16px 16px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor
components.description: JSON/XML textarea. Mono, muted wash, fills the pane.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-editor" placeholder="Paste your JSON skeleton here..."></textarea>
components.css: .ds-editor { min-height: 12rem; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--muted) / 0.3); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; resize: vertical; } .ds-editor:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 400 13px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent) / 0.6); color: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent-foreground)); }

components.name: Nav Item Active
components.description: Current tool. Fill, not a colored bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent)); color: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent-foreground)); font: 500 13px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--sidebar-ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
My Data Toolbox looks like a workbench after hours: dark, quiet, tools within reach, no theater. The visitor came to paste a skeleton, run an action, and copy a result. Chrome exists so the editors can disappear into the task.

The system is dense and cool. Inter carries every UI role. Harbor Steel is the only accent and it is scarce. Surfaces stack as inkwell → sidebar well → night paper, with hairline edges instead of shadows. Light mode inverts the same steel-and-ink pair; it is not a second identity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first (default theme); light is the same grammar inverted
One accent, used on primary actions and selection only
Flat tonal layering; no rest-state shadows
Compact Operate density: 32–36px controls, 15px titles, 4px spacing base
Editors (mono fields) occupy most of the viewport

rules.name: The One Steel Rule
rules.body: Harbor Steel appears on primary actions, focus, and selection. It does not fill backgrounds, cards, or decorative bars. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Inkwell Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay in the 209–214 hue band. Do not introduce warm grays or pure #000 / #fff slabs except on destructive text.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: No hero type, no fluid clamp headings, no second family for “tech personality.” Inter plus mono for data.

rules.name: The Editor Leads Rule
rules.body: After the rail and a one-line title, remaining pixels belong to the editors. Do not reintroduce a marketing header, hero, or duplicated page chrome.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Do not add ambient shadows, glows, or glass blur to the shell or cards.

dos: Do keep Harbor Steel scarce: primary button, focus ring, selection.
Do let the two editors fill the remaining viewport on desktop.
Do stack panes and scroll the workspace on small screens (h-full only from lg).
Do use Inter at 15 / 14 / 13 / 11px and a 4px spacing scale.
Do separate layers with 1px Bench Edge and hue-matched neutrals.
donts: Don't add rest-state card shadows, backdrop-blur headers, or gradient text.
Don't use a 4px (or thicker) accent border on nav, cards, or alerts.
Don't introduce a display serif, geometric “tech” mono as UI type, or emoji as icons.
Don't rebuild a marketing hero above the bench.
Don't invent testimonials, customer logos, or usage metrics in the chrome.
